what: The comparable plan's store calls and metered spend, as tests/e2e/writeback_cost.rs takes them: one launch of a five-node plan (a chain of three and a parallel pair) through the real engine binary and the real linked store over scripted-source; every node dispatched and settled done but one, which fails and is retried to done; one amend, one add, one reparent; a transient store outage of three failures that recovers; one rate-limited refusal carrying a two-second wait; a stop and an adopt; and closeout. calls count the plugin protocol's own methods as the source logged them, split at the launch read's connection; spent is what the source's meter charged, one request and one graphql point per answered request.

before.engine: onepipeline at cb8228d25a10d59c2d945e8a1583c6abf8337158, this branch's merge base: whole copies on a driver's first projection, after a failure and on a stop's release

after.engine: this tree: every attempt carries the difference from the landed baseline (entry 93)

creation_lookup: The one query_tasks in the write-back's calls on this branch is Engine::copy's own origin scan before it creates the add-ed node's item (onetaskgraph-core engine/copy.rs, target rule 2), which no CopyRequest field skips: one per item created, inside that attempt's project-copy. The planner ruled it stays (the onetaskgraph-side skip is their follow-up); the journey holds it to at most one per created item and to no attempt that creates nothing. The merge base's eleven come from its whole copies: each whole attempt's page of tasks, and the copies' own lookups.
